enrich_summary.reasoning_short: The marker list is dominated by immunoglobulin genes (IGHG3, IGHG2, IGHA2, IGKC, IGHG4, IGLC2, JCHAIN, IGLC3, IGHA1) and plasma cell-specific markers (SDC1, TNFRSF17, MZB1, CD38, SLAMF7, FCRL5, DERL3, XBP1-target genes). The presence of JCHAIN and IGLL5 confirms commitment to antibody secretion. The absence of B-cell maturation markers (e.g., MS4A1/CD20, CD19, PAX5) and the strong expression of TNFRSF17 (BCMA) and SDC1 (CD138) definitively distinguish plasma cells from memory or naive B cells. The enriched pathways (e.g., glycan biosynthesis hsa00533, 00531, 00603, 00604; lipid metabolism hsa00120; protein processing) reflect the high secretory load and ER stress typical of plasma cells. Although some metabolic pathways are generic, the combination of immunoglobulin genes and plasma cell markers is pathognomonic.
